Track: Coordination

## C1120 — new-Codex-task Release Asset independent restoration: ACCEPT / PASS (bounded pilot)

**Canonical task and provenance.** Rechecked [original uploader's distinct task report](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1496#issuecomment-6947423473), [C1118 conditional post-PR P housekeeping adoption](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1496#issuecomment-6947690512), [C1119 public-by-default clarification](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1496#issuecomment-6947877811), and [new independent Codex task FINAL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1496#issuecomment-6948050572). Separate task run ID `88285849-dc36-4351-888d-88a5523c226b`, actual UTC 2026-11-17 12:28:10–11, reports a genuinely empty `tempfile.mkdtemp` destination, no uploader local file/cache reuse, authenticated GitHub Release asset octet-stream GET **302→200** with Authorization not forwarded to redirected asset host, local readback and independent `wc -c` / `sha256sum` matching.

**C's independent GitHub metadata GET at review:** Release ID **448433010**, tag `archive-upload-pilot-20261117`, **draft=true**, unpublished; asset ID **758861590**, name `newlang-machine-pilot.txt`, state **uploaded**, size **34 bytes**, GitHub-declared SHA256 `63a9fed47b4cde5eedc848584e7f33d7076f61bca05b11d9f64d880c1d7f407d`. The new Codex actor reports **actual downloaded bytes 34 and locally calculated SHA256 exactly identical**, not merely a metadata lookup. C did NOT perform a second independent full byte download in this chat; the evidentiary chain is the separate Codex task's raw HTTP and local verification report corroborated by GitHub asset metadata.

**ADJUDICATION:** the **one-time new-task pilot restore checkpoint is PASS / ACCEPTED**. C1118's P Release-first **default** for eligible original measured evidence and minimal P-owned Codex Cloud local retention can now operate as previously scoped without a new C micro-GO for each archive; Git/LFS/ordinary Git/bundles remain available. No need to launch a distinct independent Codex task for every future archive: P must still upload, fetch complete actual bytes into a fresh location, verify outer length/SHA, *all required archive members*, safe restoration/bundle prerequisites, and record provenance receipt **before deleting that asset's unique local original**. Uncommitted/unreachable source, active worktree/repair data, necessary SDK and other tracks' files remain protected.

**Boundaries unchanged:** This 34-byte synthetic proof is **not** validation of real large evidence assets, every member, indefinite storage/immutability or full historical Git/LFS migration. No existing old LFS file may be deleted solely on pilot PASS; each requires separately demonstrated destination restoration. Draft release remains draft, no automatic product release or credentials exposure; Pank public-by-default under C1119 with narrowly justified exceptions. No compiler/CI/PR changes authorized. Product GO #624 PAUSED/H1 #268 HOLD. Stop affected cleanup on any download/digest/member mismatch, credential leakage, missing original provenance or unclear file custody.
